title: Smart Data Models - Open Energy Ontology - EnergyStorageObject
description: An energy storage object is an artificial object that has the function energy storage (oeo:OEO_00000159 'energy storage object', Open Energy Ontology v2.14.0, definition verbatim). Modelled generically: the specific OEO subclass (lithium-ion battery, flow battery, sensible heat storage object, underground hydrogen storage object, ...) is carried in oeoClass. Note that OEO classifies pumped hydro storage as a power plant (pumped hydro storage power plant), not as an energy storage object; use PowerPlant for those.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'EnergyStorageObject'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the original source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

name.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/name'. The name of this item.

alternateName.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/alternateName'. An alternative name for this item.

description.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/description'. A description of this item.

location.description: GeoProperty. Geojson reference to the item. Point, LineString or Polygon (RFC 7946). Not an OEO term: OEO has no direct geometry on artificial objects, so the NGSI-LD core location is used.

oeoClass.description: Relationship. The specific OEO class of this entity (rdf:type), as the class IRI. OEO v2.14.0 declares 29 classes in the 'energy storage object' hierarchy (this class and all its subclasses), all allowed here: LFP battery = oeo:OEO_00280013; NMC battery = oeo:OEO_00280012; battery = oeo:OEO_00000068; chemical energy storage object = oeo:OEO_00020363; chemical heat storage object = oeo:OEO_00310033; electrical energy storage object = oeo:OEO_00020362; energy storage object = oeo:OEO_00000159; flow battery = oeo:OEO_00000169; kinetic energy storage object = oeo:OEO_00020364; latent fluid-gaseous heat storage object = oeo:OEO_00310045; latent heat storage object = oeo:OEO_00310043; latent solid-fluid heat storage object = oeo:OEO_00310044; lead-acid battery = oeo:OEO_00280014; liquid-metal battery = oeo:OEO_00000259; lithium-ion battery = oeo:OEO_00000248; molten-salt battery = oeo:OEO_00000282; potential energy storage object = oeo:OEO_00020371; sensible fluid heat storage object = oeo:OEO_00310038; sensible heat storage object = oeo:OEO_00310037; sensible solid heat storage object = oeo:OEO_00310039; sodium-ion battery = oeo:OEO_00000376; sodium-sulphur battery = oeo:OEO_00000377; sorption heat storage object = oeo:OEO_00310034; superconducting magnetic energy storage = oeo:OEO_00000374; thermal energy storage object = oeo:OEO_00020365; thermo-chemical heat storage object = oeo:OEO_00310032; traction battery = oeo:OEO_00010026; underground fuel storage object = oeo:OEO_00010325; underground hydrogen storage object = oeo:OEO_00000429.

partOf.description: Relationship. The entity this storage object is part of, typically a GridComponent of OEO class 'energy storage unit' (oeo:OEO_00000399) or a PowerPlant (BFO 'part of').

refGridConnectionPoint.description: Relationship. The GridComponent (usually a grid node / substation) through which the object feeds into or draws from the supply grid. Not an OEO property: OEO only states that a power plant 'has part some electricity grid component' and that grid nodes are connected to each other, without a relation from a plant to an external grid node.

energyStorageCapacity.description: Property. Energy storage capacity: the maximum energy the energy storage object can store. Units:'MWh'. OEO models this as a quantity value class (oeo:OEO_00230000) linked through 'has quantity value'; flattened here to a plain number in the stated unit.

powerRating.description: Property. Power rating: the maximum power the object can convert (charge/discharge power for storage). Units:'MW'. OEO models this as a quantity value class (oeo:OEO_00230001) linked through 'has quantity value'; flattened here to a plain number in the stated unit.

efficiencyValue.description: Property. Efficiency value: the ratio between the useful outputs and the inputs of the energy transformation, as a fraction 0..1 (for storage: round-trip efficiency). Units:'C62 (ratio)'. OEO models this as a quantity value class (oeo:OEO_00140050) linked through 'has quantity value'; flattened here to a plain number in the stated unit.

operationalLifeTime.description: Property. Operational life time: the lifetime of the object, measured from the end of construction to the start of decommissioning. Units:'ANN (years)'. OEO models this as a quantity value class (oeo:OEO_00020178) linked through 'has quantity value'; flattened here to a plain number in the stated unit.

commissioningEnd.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Date'. Commissioning end: the date on which commissioning finished, i.e. the start of commercial operation (oeo:OEO_00020421, a temporal instant in OEO, flattened to an ISO 8601 date).

decommissioningStart.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Date'. Decommissioning start: the date on which decommissioning began (oeo:OEO_00020417, flattened to an ISO 8601 date).

operationalStatus.description: Property. Operational status of the object. Not an OEO term (OEO has no operating-status vocabulary for artificial objects); the values follow the Open Power System Data / BNetzA power plant list (operating, reserve, seasonal_conservation, shutdown_temporary, shutdown, special_case), plus planned and underConstruction.
